title: SUPERVISED DRIVING LOG
disclaimer: Prepared with LicenseLogger from the official Michigan Supervised Driving Log (Supervised Driving Guide). Michigan accepts other log formats: "The log that follows and the free mobile app, RoadReady®, are the preferred formats. Other driving log formats will be accepted." (MI_supervised-driving-guide.pdf p.25).
notes: Log pages are PDF pages 26-28 of the SOS Supervised Driving Guide (RoadReady template, Rev. 08/2019): 27, 34 and 13 rows.
Each page ends with a Subtotal box (Subtotal 1/2/3 Day/Night Hours); page 2 carries 'Subtotal 1 & 2'.
Hours are written as decimal hours (1.5 = 1 h 30 min) because the columns are headed 'Day Hours' / 'Night Hours'.
unfillable: Lesson No. (the guide's lesson numbers 1-13; LicenseLogger does not tag drives with them)
Segment 2 Driver Education hours (hours at the time Segment 2 started) and its signature

blocks.text: Lessons/Recommended Practice Hours: 1. Before you start the engine (1) 2. Moving, steering and stopping (1) 3. How close are you? (1) 4. Backing up (1) 5. Driving on a quiet street (5) 6. Looking ahead (5) 7. Turning around (1) 8. Parking (3) 9. Multi-lane roads (10) 10. City driving (10) 11. Freeway driving (10) 12. Roundabouts (2) 13. Winter Driving (as much as possible). Nighttime Hours: Driving time that is 30 minutes after sunset to 30 minutes before sunrise.

a person may be issued a Level 2 graduated licensing status if the person presents a certification by the parent or guardian that the person, accompanied by his or her licensed parent or legal guardian or, with the permission of the parent or legal guardian, any licensed driver 21 years of age or older, has accumulated a total of not less than 50 hours of behind-the-wheel experience including not less than 10 nighttime hours.
